1774:     case "goal_progress": {
1775:       if (state.activeGoal && isStaleGoalEvent(state.activeGoal, event)) {
1776:         return state;
1777:       }
1778:       const msg: GoalProgressMessage = {
1779:         kind: "goal_progress",
1780:         id: freshId("goal"),
1781:         goalId: event.goalId,
1782:         status: event.status,
1783:         round: event.round,
1784:         gaps: event.gaps,
1785:         turnsRemaining: event.turnsRemaining,
1786:         stopBlocksRemaining: event.stopBlocksRemaining,
1787:         nearest: event.nearest,
1788:       };
1789:       // The "approaching_limit" marker carries the "再续" button. Only prune it
1790:       // when the moment has TRULY passed:
1791:       //  - met/exhausted → the limit dimension settled / the run stopped.
1792:       //  - a NEW approaching_limit → never stack two (re-announced after extend).
1793:       // A "not_met" event means the goal is still advancing and may still be
1794:       // nearing the cap, so the button must stay (fixes B2: previously not_met
1795:       // pruned the button within the same turn it appeared).
1796:       const dropApproaching =
1797:         event.status === "met" ||
1798:         event.status === "exhausted" ||
1799:         event.status === "approaching_limit";
1800:       const base = dropApproaching
1801:         ? state.messages.filter(
1802:             (m) => !(m.kind === "goal_progress" && m.status === "approaching_limit"),
1803:           )
1804:         : state.messages;
1805:       // Track the active goal's round; clear it when the goal settles
1806:       // (met = achieved, exhausted = gave up). not_met/approaching_limit keep
1807:       // it active and bump the round so the popover shows "第 N 轮".
1808:       const activeGoal =
1809:         event.status === "met" || event.status === "exhausted"
1810:           ? null
1811:           : state.activeGoal
1812:             ? {
1813:                 ...state.activeGoal,
1814:                 round: event.round,
1815:                 revision: event.revision ?? state.activeGoal.revision,
1816:               }
1817:             : state.activeGoal;
1818:       return { ...state, messages: [...base, msg], activeGoal };
